content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm new to [product_name]. I've created a program with an 8-page menu showing daily on/off times for 8 pumps that relate to 8 outputs. I would like to change these times directly from the operator screen, but haven't found a way except by entering parameters from the operator device and choosing the block. Any suggestions would be appreciated.

You need to set up the parameters for time on and time off within the corresponding message text. Once you transfer the program, select the right message text and start [product_name]. When selected, hold down the ESC key for over 2 seconds until a black bar appears on the display. Now you can use the cursor up/down to choose which field to modify. Once a field is selected, press OK — the cursor will become a blinking box. Then use the left/right cursor to choose the position to change, and up/down to edit the value. After making changes, press OK again; the cursor turns back to a black bar. You can then select another field to adjust or press ESC to exit.

Thank you for the explanation; it was extremely helpful. Previously, I used the approach shown in application examples, but this method for changing the time setting is much easier and more user-friendly.

Hello [user_name], in general, it's not always the same for every user. Some have rejected this method in favor of adjusting setpoints using the function keys on the counter instead. It really depends on individual user preferences.

analysis.insight_summary: The conversation highlights that adjusting timer settings for pumps via the operator screen in [product_name] can initially be confusing for new users. Step-by-step instructions help make the process much simpler, but preferences for parameter adjustments vary — some users prefer direct modification with function keys over navigation through message texts.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want to be able to easily and directly change on/off times for several outputs from the operator screen, preferably without going through complex menu navigation.
